note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 2 affiliation evidence corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, evidence, acceptance, or release.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation functional evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Scenario identity, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.affected_requirement: Inherited governance-kernel lifecycle invariants and AEDOM-V12-007.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation contract evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Contract version, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.affected_requirement: Inherited contract governance covering commands, queries, resources, events, webhooks, callbacks, providers, files, batches, and migrations.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Request timeout is not command failure.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation integration evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Integration scope, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Mocked provider result is not provider integration evidence is not operational proof.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation event and webhook evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.affected_requirement: Inherited outbox and event governance and AEDOM-V12-007.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Event delivered is not business effect reconciled.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation provider integration evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Provider state, effective period, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Mocked provider result is not provider integration evidence is not operational proof.
